opennyai_summary.facts:
A perusal of the order impugned dated 05/05/2012 (Annexure P/1) passed by the Collector,
Division Rewa reflects that the Collector while disposing of the appeal has extended liberty to the petitioner to approach the Collector, in terms of Section 11(4) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
Therefore, as the petitioner has relegated to take recourse to remedy in terms of Section 11(4) of the Act of 2013, this petition stands disposed of while reserving the aforesaid liberty with the petitioner.
